text.description_html:
Brass Accents A07-K5030, Solid Brass Horse and Horseshoe Door Knocker

This design harkens back to when cowboys nailed an upturned horseshoe over the barn door for good luck. Now you can have the luck of a cowboy on your own homestead. The beautifully detailed horse featured in the middle of the horseshoe, makes this piece truly unique.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance. Their products are hand finished in the USA. They are one of the world's leading crafters of cast-brass and hot-forged decorative brass hardware.

This Antique Brass Horse and Horseshoe Door Knocker is Surface Mounted (screws to the face of the door) with included matching finish wood screws.

Specifications of the Dude Ranch Horseshoe Door Knocker:

  • Height: 5-1/4"
  • Width: 5"
  • Max Thickness: 3/4"
  • Surface Mounted
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Antique Brass

** This item is being discontinued. Limited quantities available, Only 1 Left.
